app.tagline: Your business website, made by talking.
home.title: {app_name}
home.intro: Tell us about your business by voice or send a photo of your price list. We build a website that works well on phones, test it the way your customers will, and show you how ready it is.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: {app_name} helps small businesses make a website. This page explains what we store, why, for how long, and how to delete it.
privacy.why: To build and run the business website, to pass customer enquiries to the business, and to keep the service secure and working.
privacy.store_title: What we store and for how long
privacy.voice: Voice recordings: deleted right after processing. If the owner agreed to keep one, it is deleted after 30 days.
privacy.profile: Business profile, photos and website: kept until the owner deletes the site.
privacy.enquiries: Customer enquiries (name, phone number and message): kept for 90 days.
privacy.delete_owner: Owners can delete their site and all its data with one action in their app. The site and their access stop at once; the data is wiped at once, or within an hour if a test of the site is still running.
privacy.delete_email: You can also ask us to delete data by writing to {email}.
site.sample_no_phone: Sample business: no real phone number
privacy.console_logs: Technical console log: a small log of about 2 MB, kept by size and overwritten automatically when full.
privacy.logs_redacted: Both logs are redacted and never contain recordings, secrets or full phone numbers.
